positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
●	Developed features for Spok Go, a communications platform used in healthcare facilities
●	Remotely worked on the application’s full-stack with a team of Engineers and Architects
●	Provisioned resources and facilitated performance optimization using AWS

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
●	Built a maintainable, efficient inventory control solution for warehouse users
●	Initiated and troubleshot deployments of microservices, plugins, and stream consumers
●	Interacted with other delivery teams to extend their code bases and schedule releases
●	Collaborated with a team of Engineers and Analysts from story grooming to deployment

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
●	Built web applications and services used by internal employees and policyholders
●	Collaborated with a team of Software Engineers, Business Analysts, and Product Owners
●	Contributed to the entire software lifecycle, from requirements analysis to deployment

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
•  Consistently produced clean, efficient code for enterprise applications
•  Collaborated with a team of Developers, Architects, and Project Managers
•  Quickly adapted to new technology stacks as new projects arose

positions.title: Section Lead Teaching Assistant (Introductory C++ For Scientists & Engineers)
positions.description:
•	Explained abstract programming concepts to students in the lab section of the course
•	Communicated lab procedures and expectations to groups of 30+ students
•	Assisted students in problem solving and debugging logical errors
•	Collaborated with colleagues in grading 400+ exam copies, 3 times per semester

positions.title: Curatorial Assistant
positions.description:
•	Digitized hundreds of drawers of insect biodiversity
•	Organized and synthesized high-resolution image files
•	Recorded count data from specimens collected or purchased by the entomology department

positions.title: Homicide Research Intern
positions.description:
•	Retrieved, formatted, and archived data related to homicides within the United States
•	Summarized and presented research findings to colleagues

volunteerExperiences.description: Delivering meals to clients in the Twin Cities metro area suffering from cancer, AIDS, MS, and other chronic illnesses.
Assisted the instructor in teaching remedial English to local students, who mostly consisted of immigrants and refugees, as well as leading personalized instruction in small groups.
